name: remove the heaviest edge that keeps the graph connected
mechanism: consider edges in decreasing weight and delete each one whose removal leaves the graph connected

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Reverse-delete algorithm' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms / Routing for graphs:

fails_when: each connectivity test is a traversal; slow
